Enable authority in a paired release with rollback tooling.

resolution: Define one terminal predicate: zero open contracts, zero owned working orders, and complete authoritative state.
Apply the same predicate to every receipt and restart path.
Treat unknown statuses as waiting or manual intervention and reconcile/cancel residual owned orders before completion.
Persist phase deadlines and operator-visible ambiguity.
acceptance: closed plus one owned working order remains waiting.
Every receipt status has a table-driven terminality test.
Partial fill, rejected cancel, stale state, restart, and late residual fill are covered.
Completed is reachable only through the shared terminal predicate.
deployment: Land the reproduced case as a red regression.
Replay historical controls and restart fixtures.
Run Sim/PRAC flatten with delayed cancellation and stream lag.
Require zero residual owned orders through the soak before armed promotion.
